visual_description: A heavy-duty industrial saw resembling a large chainsaw but with a circular diamond-tipped blade instead of a chain. It features a dual-handle grip and an attachment for a water hose (to suppress dust). The blade is dusty and shows signs of cutting through stratified rock.

constraints.material: Gritty, industrial orange and black plastic; steel blade with visible diamond grit on the edge.
constraints.logic: The ultimate 'Overburden' tool for the hardest rock types.
